Anti-TG autoantibodies bind to  
thyroglobulin and affect thyroid 
hormone synthesis, storage and  
release.

Antithyroid  
peroxidase 
antibody  
(Anti-TPO or 
TPO-AB)
Anti-TPO blood test used in the 
diagnosis of thyroid diseases, 
such as Hashimoto’s thyroiditis 
or chronic lympocytic thyroiditis 
(in children).
High prevelance of thyroid  
autoantibodies in celiac and 
rheumatoid arthritis patients
Thyroid microsomal antibodies act 
on section of the microsome in 
the thyroid cell and initiate inflam-
matory and cytotoxic effects on 
the thyroid follicle.
Recommend investigation of gluten 
intolerance if elevated Anti-TPO.
TPO AB ,9 IU/mL
Anti-TPO often 
tested in conjunc-
tion with Anti-TG 
test.
Most sensitive assay for antimi-
crosomal antibody.
Nutritional considerations are  
vitamin E and selenium co- 
factors for production of TPO 
enzyme.
